prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: layered tower animation sprite atlas for a top-down dungeon tower-defense browser game.
Input images 1-4 are style/material/type references ONLY, not edit targets. Create NEW SEPARATE ASSEMBLY PARTS to let the engine rotate a turret while its foundation stays fixed. Match chunky charcoal stone, brown timber, brass edges, cyan frost, purple lightning, green ballista and strong cartoon outlines from references.
ONE landscape alpha-transparent PNG in a STRICT THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid of SIX equally sized square cells, no borders or gutters. Camera directly overhead for rotating weapon parts, symmetric around the vertical centerline. Every part centered on the exact cell center; visible art stays within the middle 78% width/height, identical shared scale.
Cell 1 (top left): ONE stationary square stone/timber tower foundation with a flat empty circular brass mounting socket in its center. Short front face allowed but no weapon or crystal.
Cell 2 (top middle): ONE detachable charcoal/brass CANNON turret head seen directly overhead, a clear long single barrel pointing STRAIGHT UP (12 o'clock), round pivot/breech centered at the exact cell center. Muzzle near y=18% of the cell. No base or pedestal.
Cell 3 (top right): ONE detachable frost turret head, compact blue crystal mounted on a circular brass pivot at exact center, short clearly directional ice-firing nozzle pointing STRAIGHT UP, with cyan tip near y=18%. No foundation.
Cell 4 (bottom left): ONE detachable lightning turret head, round purple orb and two small brass coils around centered pivot, directional purple firing nozzle pointing STRAIGHT UP, with tip near y=18%. No foundation.
Cell 5 (bottom middle): ONE detachable long-range crossbow/ballista turret head directly overhead, green aiming crystal, broad symmetric bow left/right, arrow rail and single arrow pointing STRAIGHT UP, rear pivot at exact cell center, arrow tip near y=18%. No foundation.
Cell 6 (bottom right): ONE small amber-white muzzle-flash burst centered in the cell, rays pointing mainly STRAIGHT UP, standalone animation overlay.
All parts fit together at the same center when composited; the turret heads must NOT include the stationary square stone walls, tall legs or timber foundation. Heads visibly point north, do not point diagonally. Hand-painted friendly dark-fantasy game art with bold readable silhouettes. True alpha transparency outside each individual part; no text, numbers, grid lines, UI, checkerboard, background scene, watermark.
